title: Australia Declared War On Emus. The Emus Won.
description:
In 1932, the Australian military sent soldiers with machine guns to deal with an emu problem. It did not go well for the soldiers.

#shorts #sciencefacts #history #didyouknow

scenes.text: In 1932, Australia declared war on emus. The emus won.
Farmers in Western Australia were dealing with around twenty thousand emus trampling crops, and asked the government for military help.
The Royal Australian Artillery sent three soldiers, two mounted machine guns, and ten thousand rounds of ammunition, to cull the birds.
It went badly almost immediately. The guns jammed constantly, and emus can run over thirty miles an hour, far faster than anyone expected.
Each emu group even posted its own lookout bird, which would spot the soldiers early and scatter the rest before a single shot landed.
After a month of fighting, fewer than a thousand emus had been killed, out of the original ten thousand rounds fired. The military withdrew, and news of the loss made headlines worldwide.
If you were in charge, what would you have tried differently to win the Emu War?
